LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.0: The enemy can be bombed countless times by you, but you can almost only be bombed once. Please be responsible for your colonists and build a good air and missile defense system for them.
LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.1: Anti-air missiles can take on anti-satellite missions. To improve the success rate, try to predict and launch missiles before the satellite passes overhead. If it is difficult to hit a distant satellite, you can send a caravan to camp directly under the satellite's orbit, or launch missiles from an orbital base.
LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.2: Try not to provoke factions above the Ultratech age - their missile attacks are terrifying, really.
LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.3: Hostile faction settlements above the Spacer age have anti-missile capabilities, but their defense channels can be overloaded. Try using cheap missiles to bait out their interceptors.
LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.4: A reconnaissance satellite can force-load a map, making it easier for you to perform tactical strikes. To launch a reconnaissance satellite, after researching the corresponding technology, use heavy liquid rockets like the DF-5 or LGM-118 to launch it.
LanguageData.IRBM_Tips.tips.5: In the absence of a reconnaissance satellite, enemy tactical missiles only attack targets intended by faction members - if members of two factions are fighting in your colony, you can try turning off the air defense system and let them bomb each other... I'm really not kidding.
